_comment: v86 camp/quest/system strip labels for tools/patch_camp_strips.py. Keys under 'labels' are rect-table indices (rect tables parsed from the resource files themselves via strip_patcher.parse_rect_table — do NOT add coordinates here). 'jp' documents the original pre-rendered kanji per build/recon_v86/strip-family-offsets/manifest.json (text_jp is authoritative for which rect gets which string). 'en' = null means the rect is deliberately left untouched.

R1359._resource: 1359_type02.raw camp/pause menu strip, 256x256 PSMT4, pixels @1312, rect table @34656 (16 x 128x24), GS-byte-verified

R1367._resource: 1367_type02.raw quest-result/camp misc strip, 256x256 PSMT4, pixels @1904, rect table @35632 (45 rects), GS-byte-verified. Only the Japanese label rects below are patched; digits, 'Press O Button', PM, L1R1 and icons stay untouched.

R1910._resource: 1910_type02.raw system menu banner strip, 256x256 PSMT4, pixels @1840, rect table @35312 (6 x 192x40 banners). Render-verified only — patch_camp_strips.py re-validates structure + banner alignment and SKIPS the whole resource (exit 0, SKIPPED line) if anything is off. Banners are art+text composites: only the dark glyph ink (idx<=9) inside the central plaque box (x 44..170, y rel 8..32) is erased and in-painted with the median of surrounding bright banner texture (idx>=10); the left/right scrollwork ornaments (x<44, x>=170) stay pixel-identical. English is then alpha-blended in dark ink onto the cleaned plaque. EXIT (rect 4) is already English and untouched.
